categories.main_business_segments: Guangzhou Great Power Energy and Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the lithium-ion battery industry, including lithium-ion batteries, primary batteries (such as lithium iron, lithium manganese, zinc-air), and sodium-ion batteries. Its products serve energy storage, new energy vehicles, light power, and consumer electronics sectors. The company also engages in battery system integration and provides comprehensive energy storage solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced battery technologies including high-energy density platforms, large cylindrical full tab technology, LTSC low-temperature technology, and solid-state batteries with composite inorganic ceramic electrolytes. It employs automated and digitalized manufacturing with MES management for quality control, achieving up to 95% automation in energy storage cell production. R&D emphasizes materials, structure, and system innovation with over 900 patents and collaborations with top universities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in renewable energy storage, electric vehicles (including two-wheelers, commercial vehicles, drones, heavy trucks, and ships), consumer electronics (smart audio devices, e-cigarettes, personal care, smart home), and light power applications. Major markets are China, the US, Europe, Southeast Asia, South America, Africa, and countries along the Belt and Road Initiative.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Guangzhou, Zhuhai, Zhumadian, Changzhou, Liuzhou, Foshan, Quzhou, and Vietnam. It has established overseas offices in the US, Germany, Japan, Singapore, Indonesia, India, Turkey, Spain, and Chile, and is expanding local production and integration facilities globally to serve major energy storage markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangzhou Great Power Energy is positioned in the midstream of the lithium battery supply chain, focusing on battery cell manufacturing, system integration, and sales. It sources raw materials such as cathode, anode, separator, and electrolyte from upstream suppliers and sells directly to downstream manufacturers and customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technology-driven development with strategic R&D in solid-state batteries, large-capacity cells (600Ah+), high energy density and low-temperature platforms, and sodium-ion battery technologies. It aims to enhance battery safety, energy density, and cycle life, while expanding manufacturing automation and global footprint. R&D investments focus on flexible solid electrolytes, lithium metal anodes, battery life prediction, and high-temperature performance improvements.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of lithium-ion batteries, primary batteries, and sodium-ion batteries to downstream manufacturers and customers. The company also earns income from integrated energy storage system solutions and related services. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models but focuses on product sales and project-based contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company ranks among the top global lithium battery manufacturers, recognized as a BloombergNEF Tier 1 global energy storage supplier and a top player in China’s industrial and residential energy storage markets. It competes with leading Chinese and international battery producers, leveraging its comprehensive product portfolio, technological innovation, and global delivery capabilities to maintain a strong market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 7.96 billion, a 14.83% increase from 2023, but experienced a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 252 million due to intensified market competition and cost pressures. Total assets reached RMB 16.87 billion, with a net asset value of RMB 5.09 billion. The company continues to invest heavily in R&D and capacity expansion, with a focus on long-term growth despite short-term profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Guangzhou Great Power Energy emphasizes high safety, high efficiency, and long cycle life in its battery products, supported by rigorous quality control and international certifications. Its differentiated technologies include large-capacity cells, solid-state batteries with intrinsic safety features, and advanced thermal management. The company offers tailored solutions across diverse applications, backed by global project delivery experience and comprehensive lifecycle service, creating strong customer trust and competitive advantage.
